content: nwg-look (github README, verified): GTK settings editor for wlroots Waylands; edits gsettings directly (gtk-theme, icon-theme, cursor-theme, font-name, font hinting/antialiasing/rgba), exports ~/.config/gtk-3.0/settings.ini, buttons-images etc. for LXAppearance compat; -a apply, -x export, -r restore. Scope = GTK look only: NO wallpaper, NO blur/opacity, NO keybinds.
